en_title: EA Acquisition by Saudi Arabia's PIF, Silver Lake, and Jared Kushner's Affinity Partners Is Now Complete
cn_title: EA完成55亿美元(约合人民币372亿元)收购
subtitle: 资本交易尘埃落定
opus_summary: EA宣布完成55亿美元(约合人民币372亿元)收购交易，买方财团由沙特公共投资基金、Silver Lake和Affinity Partners组成，EA由此正式成为私有公司。

quality_review.review_notes: Independent bilingual self-review completed for coverage, attribution, uncertainty, numbers, dates, currency, units, names, media, and natural Chinese news style.

paragraphs.en: EA has officially completed its $55 billion acquisition to an investor group comprised of Saudia Arabia's Public Investment Fund, Silver Lake, and Affinity Partners.
paragraphs.cn: EA已完成55亿美元(约合人民币372亿元)的收购交易，买方是由沙特阿拉伯公共投资基金、Silver Lake和Affinity Partners组成的投资者集团。

paragraphs.en: Announced on August 4, 2026, this massive business move has been nearly one year in the making, first announced in September 2025.
paragraphs.cn: 这项于2026年8月4日宣布的重大商业交易历时近一年，最初于2025年9月公布。

paragraphs.en: "This moment recognizes the extraordinary people whose creativity, ambition and passion have made EA one of the world's leading interactive entertainment companies," Andrew Wilson, Chairman & CEO of Electronic Arts, said in a press release.
paragraphs.cn: EA董事长兼首席执行官Andrew Wilson在新闻稿中表示：「这一时刻彰显了EA卓越人才的成就，他们凭借创造力、雄心和热情，让EA成为全球领先的互动娱乐公司之一。」

paragraphs.en: "We're entering this next chapter from a position of strength with partners who share our vision and ambition. Together, we'll invest boldly, accelerate innovation, and build the next generation of games and experiences for the hundreds of millions of players and fans who inspire us every day."
paragraphs.cn: 「我们将与志同道合、共享愿景和抱负的合作伙伴一起，以强劲姿态迈入下一篇章。我们将共同大胆投资、加速创新，为每天激励我们的数亿玩家和影迷打造下一代游戏与体验。」

paragraphs.en: “Having been a minority investor in the company for more than five years, we have a deep understanding of EA’s unique platform, massive global sports and gaming franchises, and iconic IP,” Turqi Alnowaiser, Deputy Governor and Head of International Investments at PIF, added.
paragraphs.cn: PIF副行长兼国际投资主管Turqi Alnowaiser补充道：「作为EA超过五年的少数股东，我们深入了解EA独特的平台、规模庞大的全球体育与游戏系列，以及标志性知识产权。」

paragraphs.en: “Entertainment and sports are key areas of strategic focus for PIF, and are among the fastest growing and evolving sectors around the world. Together, the Consortium is uniquely positioned to be a long-term partner to EA’s management team in driving sustained growth and innovation for EA and the industry.”
paragraphs.cn: 「娱乐和体育是PIF战略重点关注的领域，也是全球发展和变化最快的行业之一。在推动EA管理层及整个行业持续增长和创新方面，该财团具备成为EA长期合作伙伴的独特条件。」
